description: Find all known vulnerabilities for an open-source package, optionally at a specific version, via the OSV.dev database. Omit version to get every vuln known for the package. Returns a compact summary array (id, summary, aliases, severity, references). Keyless.

version.description: Optional package version, e.g. "4.17.20". If given, only vulns affecting that version are returned; if omitted, all vulns for the package are returned.

name: query_package_vulns
title: Query Package Vulns
